title: scirpus × contortus
intro: Scirpus × contortus, commonly known as umbrella sedge, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Scirpus × contortus include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, which have been utilized in traditional medicine for centuries.
